label: caiso 18 outage regate
definition: Outage re-gate of the caiso-15 all-flags keeper (commitment, priced-interchange, 2024 hydro repin + EIA-930 monthly, gas-hub-basis overlay, import gas-coupling + solar-shape) on the net-load-filtered CAMPD unit-outage CSV (commit b0c41cb; CAISO outage GW-days -37%). ONLY the outage input changed vs caiso-15; byte-faithful re-solve from run_config.json. RESULT (2024): body COOLS mean 42.00->41.17 (resid +6.15->+5.32), p50 46.80->46.34, p95 63.73->62.96; negative tail PRESERVED (neg 407->408 @ 91.9% precision, recall 49.5->49.7%). Cooling is localized OVERNIGHT (h00-04 each ~-1.1: more available CC lowers the gas-set price) - the gas-bound +44% block in DIAGNOSIS-caiso-body-overprice; midday import floor (h10-14, ~+12.5) and the under-priced evening ramp are UNCHANGED (orthogonal to outages, as predicted). FUEL MIX: gas +4%->+5% vs EIA-923 (71.07->71.85 TWh); the re-gate slightly WORSENS the CC-over/peaker-under split (CC_REGULAR 51.85->53.03, CT_PEAKER 0.16->0.03, ST_GAS 3.19->2.76) - fewer outages let commitment lean even harder on CC, confirming the mix defect is a COMMITMENT/merit-order property, not an availability one (TASK-2 hypothesis 1). Clean LMP win; mix defect is a separate commitment issue.
